verses.text: Ach in Diosal, toxonton in Diosal ach. Tzach in nib'ej t'a smasanil in k'ool, tzach snib'ej in pixan icha tz'aj snib'an nhab' lum lum takinh.
In gana tzach wiloch t'a a templo, ol cham wal in k'ool wilan a poder yet' a tzikikial.
Te niwan yelk'och a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh b'aj pitzan in t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Yuj chi', ol ach in b'itej.
Yakb'an pitzan in, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol in mojb'ejk'e in k'ab' t'ayach t'a in lesal.
Wach'xonhej ol ajkan in k'ool uuj, icha junok mach syak' wal snib'ej yet' junok wael te wach'. Yet' in tzalajk'olal ol ach in b'itej.
Ha t'ak'walil ayik jichan inxo ek'i, tzach in naub'tanhani, aynhejoch in pensar t'ayach.
Ha ach ton tzach kolwaj wet'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin na' icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun.
Junnhej waj het'ok sik'lab'il. Max in aktejel-laj yet' a wach' k'ab'.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, ol b'atkan heb' t'a yol sjulal b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak.
Ol miljokcham heb' t'a k'een espada, haxo nok' okes ol chianb'at heb'.
Ha inxo pax rey in tik jun, ol wak' tzalajb'ok in k'ool het'ok ach in Diosal. Masanil heb' tzach ak'an b'inaj b'aj syak' sti', ol tzalaj heb'. Haxo pax heb' tz'esan jun, ol keekaxkan heb' uuj.
